facts.text: Under the BU Promise, Boston University meets 100% of demonstrated financial need without loans for first-time domestic undergraduates, with families earning $75,000 or less paying $0 in net cost of attendance.

sources.title: Full Tuition Figures | Admissions - Boston University
sources.quote: We will meet 100% of demonstrated financial need for first-time, first-year students who are US citizens and permanent residents—without loans.

facts.text: Under the BU Promise, admitted first-year domestic students from families earning between $150,001 and $200,000 with typical assets pay no more than $20,000 per academic year toward attendance costs.

sources.title: Full Tuition Figures | Admissions - Boston University
sources.quote: Under this program, admitted first-year students from families with annual household incomes below $200,000 and typical assets can expect to pay no more than $20,000 per academic year toward the cost of attendance.
